Rwys 8, 15, climbing right turn direct VNY VOR/DME.
Rwy 26, climb direct VNY VOR/DME.
Rwy 33, Climbing left turn direct VNY VOR/DME.
All aircraft continue climb in VNY holding pattern (SE, left turns, 295° inbound) to cross VNY VOR/DME at or above 5100, then westbound on V326 to GINNA or eastbound on V186 to DARTS.
